description: Create a task (follow-up) in Dynamics 365 Sales, optionally regarding an account, contact, lead or opportunity (regarding_entity + regarding_id). due: YYYY-MM-DD (noon Berlin) or ISO time; priority low/normal/high. WRITES into the customer's Dynamics 365 — it goes through the permission gate and the Dynamics write log (audit_log dynamics_write).

due.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD (noon Berlin) or ISO time

fields.description: further Dataverse columns by logical name (lower case, e.g. {"address1_city":"Leipzig"}); lookups as {"parentaccountid@odata.bind":"/accounts(<GUID>)"}

regarding_entity.description: Entity type of the related record (with regarding_id)

name: create_dynamics_task
